scope: Rd16, Rd32 and ScanFat in src/hack_scsd.c
outcome: No additional parser fix indicated. Rd16 returns u32, so its upper-half shift is already unsigned; an initially proposed cast was removed as unnecessary.
verification: check_scsd_fat_directory.py executes production readers and directory scanner with a controlled 512-byte sector
All 65536 high cluster halves, three low halves and FAT16/FAT32 decoding (393216 cases)
All 256 attribute bytes at every sector entry position (4096 cases), including last-entry matches
Deleted entries, directory terminators and a full nonmatching sector preserve prior file metadata
Little-endian file size decoding with bit 31 set and surrounding buffer canaries verified
Trapping shift sanitizer passes both current source and baseline 3034d49
limitations: Controlled filesystem fields and sector buffers. This does not validate cluster-number legality/reserved bits, FAT chain traversal, mount geometry, SD transport, writes or hardware behavior. Whole-file review remains incomplete.
